info.title: deps.dev projects
info.description: Google's Open Source Insights. Free, keyless, no account. `projectHealth` returns a repository's headline facts and its full OpenSSF Scorecard — an overall score out of ten plus fourteen named checks. The project key is a host-qualified path (`github.com/apache/logging-log4j2`) and must be percent-encoded, slashes included, because it is a single path segment.

get.summary: A project's headline facts and its OpenSSF Scorecard
get.description:
Returns `{projectKey, starsCount, forksCount, openIssuesCount, license, description, ossFuzz, scorecard: {overallScore, date, repository, checks: [{name, score, reason, documentation}]}}`.

Two things about the scores. `overallScore` is 0-10. A CHECK score of -1 does NOT mean zero — it means the check could not run or does not apply, and averaging it in silently drags a good project down; every view here excludes it and says how many were excluded. A project deps.dev has never indexed returns 404 rather than an empty scorecard.

parameters.name: projectKey
parameters.description: Host-qualified repository path, e.g. `github.com/apache/logging-log4j2`. Percent-encoded — the slashes too.
